desc:
🏃 This is the place to carry your skills onto professional pitches, tense, rivalled, and competitive! ⚡️

 ✨ This is a enhanced version of Real Futbol for more competitive moments and gameplay, aimed 🎯 to be used by the community in hosting matches and maintaining their Fan Leagues!

❗If you haven't played Real Futbol, make sure to do so NOW! https://www.roblox.com/games/14004668761/Real-Futbol

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE:
- To supply Leagues with the best items in the game, the shop is modified to be free. However, any passes purchased apply in Real Futbol, NOT RF Fan Leagues.
- It is recommended you play on Private Servers with organized management to make your experience enjoyable. This game is not meant to be played with Public Servers- refer to Real Futbol above.

Join the community server to stay up to date on new updates for Real Futbol and Real Futsal and join its Fan Leagues!
